why_disabled: No Auto-Pigeon Extractor release has been published yet, so there is no immutable version and no digest to pin. A pin filled in from a branch head or from a `latest` URL would be the exact thing NEW_246I1 forbids: a bundle whose contents nobody can state in advance. Until a published AUE release exists, the Companion's release assets are published on their own and the signed managed-acquisition path joins the two at run time — which is the documented, verified route and not a second one.
